court, while discharging the petitioner for offences under Sections 304A/308 of Indian Penal Code
(hereinafter referred to as IPC) concluded that, prima facie a case for offences under Sections 304

therefore, being owner of the premises, he was in the knowledge that such act could cause death of
any of the labourer working there and therefore, the trial court was right when it observed that
prima facie offences under Section 304 Part II read with Section 308/34 IPC were made out against
